newsitem.title: USA: Date extended for Katz Media tender.
newsitem.headline: Date extended for Katz Media tender.

text.p: Evergreen Media Corp and Chancellor Broadcasting Co said Friday that they have extended the expiration date of the cash tender offer of their jointly owned subsidiary, Morris Acquisition Corp, to acquire any and all outstanding shares of common stock of Katz Media Group Inc for $11 per share.
The companies said the new expiration date would be 1700 EDT/ 2100 GMT September 25, instead of 0000 EDT/ 0400 GMT August 14.

Evergreen said it has received a request for additional information from the US Department of Justice with respect to its filing under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 in connection with the offer.
The offer is being extended, said Evergreen, in order to comply with the request.
Katz Media is a full-service media representation firm serving radio and television stations, cable television systems and Internet media outlets.
Chancellor and Evergreen own and operate radio stations across the United States.
